profile.reading: This Nabiax facility, module N3, is 1 of 3 modules on the operator own Julian Camarillo campus at Calle Julian Camarillo 29, Madrid, Spain, near Madrid Barajas airport. The campus was inaugurated in phases between 1995 and 2011. All 3 modules are built to Tier III specifications with 2N group topology and N+1 chiller and CRAH cooling. The operator own page gives combined campus totals of 10,000 square meters, 10 MW of current IT power expandable to 15 MW, and 29 IT rooms, but does not break these figures down by individual module, so no module specific capacity or square footage is attributed to this record. The operator states the campus runs on 100 percent renewable energy and is 100 percent carrier neutral.
